Beyond industry and services, there are cooperatives in every sector of the economy in Europe and worldwide. CECOP is the sectoral organisation of Cooperatives Europe, which brings together cooperatives from all sectors. CECOP is also the European regional organisation of CICOPA, the world sectoral organisation for industry and services - itself part of the International Cooperative Alliance (ICA). CECOP is a member of Social Economy Europe, Social Services Europe, REVES and Social Platform.
